description.value: Memphis Blues is an award-winning Southern BBQ chain with a well-established location on Vancouver's cycling-friendly Commercial Drive, recognized by Georgia Straight, Vancouver Magazine, and Food Network Canada for its applewood-smoked meats cooked low and slow on-site daily. The restaurant operates a lively dine-in format with occasional special events and a catering operation serving up to 800 guests. It sits on one of Vancouver's busiest cycling corridors and offers a hearty, casual meal for riders passing through the East Side.

bike_parking_detail: 3 racks within 100m: stands (2 spaces) at 52m; stands (3 spaces) at 68m; stands (2 spaces) at 86m. Total: 7 spaces.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website confirms an active, multi-location award-winning BBQ restaurant at 1342 Commercial Drive, Vancouver, matching OSM address and phone exactly.
